methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified by fetching each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch (wati.io/pricing, respond.io/pricing + respond.io/security, trengo.com/pricing, aisensy.com/pricing/usd, gallabox.com/pricing, doubletick.io/pricing, zoko.io/pricing, 360dialog.com/pricing + docs.360dialog.com/docs/get-started/pricing, twilio.com/en-us/whatsapp/pricing). WATI's pricing page renders prices via dynamic JS not extractable by WebFetch; prices were corroborated across multiple independent analyses (costbench.com, flowcart.ai) plus WATI help-center references and corrected from the draft's outdated $29/$99/$249 to the current $59/$119/$279 (annual-billing headline). Interakt's USD page (interakt.shop/pricing-us) returns navigation-only content via WebFetch; entry plan ~$12/mo is corroborated, but the Growth-tier USD figure is reported inconsistently across third-party sources ($35, $41, and $55) and could not be confirmed on an official live page, so it is set to null per NULL-BEATS-A-GUESS rather than asserting an unverified number. Monthly prices reflect base platform fee only; Meta per-conversation/template charges are excluded from monthlyUsd and noted per plan. Trengo prices are EUR as published; no official USD price exists so monthlyUsd is null with EUR in notes. 360dialog USD prices taken from the official USD toggle in docs.360dialog.com. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
